q.en: How do I make an appointment?

a.id: Tanyakan waktu yang tersedia melalui nomor WhatsApp tercantum.
a.en: Ask about availability using the listed WhatsApp number.

a.id: Daftar biaya belum tersedia di sini. Mintalah estimasi kepada klinik.
a.en: Prices are not available here. Ask the clinic for an estimate.

a.id: Konfirmasikan jadwal terbaru kepada tim klinik.
a.en: Confirm the current schedule with the clinic.

a.id: Situs klinik menyebut beberapa mitra asuransi. Konfirmasikan polis dan prosedurnya kepada admin; respons situs Juli2026 menyatakan BPJS belum dilayani.
a.en: The clinic lists several insurance partners. Confirm your policy and requirements with the clinic; a July2026 website response states BPJS is not accepted.

a.id: Tanyakan dokumen dan persiapan yang diperlukan kepada klinik.
a.en: Ask the clinic which documents and preparation are needed.
